title: Jev VAD: Client-side Turn Detection
tagline: Let a language-model judge decide when the user is done and when to barge in.
description: Run Agora Conversational AI in manual turn mode and drive start-of-speech, end-of-speech and interruption from the web client: a mic-energy gate opens the turn, TypeSafe's Jev scores the live transcript to close it or to tell a real interruption from a backchannel.
author: Agora
